# EU DPP Provider (eudppprovider.com)

> Enterprise Digital Product Passport (DPP) platform and sovereign data vault provider under Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 (EU Battery Regulation) and ESPR (EU 2024/1781).

## Core Identity & Positioning
- **Brand**: EU DPP Provider
- **Domain**: https://eudppprovider.com
- **Official Business Desk**: info@eudppprovider.com
- **Operations Centers**: Frankfurt am Main & Munich (Germany) / Shanghai (China)
- **Primary Focus**: Digital Product Passport compliance software and 10-year sovereign data hosting for Electric Vehicles (EV), Light Means of Transport (LMT / E-Bike ≤25kg), and Stationary Industrial Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS >2kWh).

## Key Regulatory Milestones & Mandates
- **Mandatory Enforcement Date**: February 18, 2027 (Articles 77 & 78, Regulation EU 2023/1542)
- **EU DPP Central Registry**: DG GROW operational registry integration (`registry.product-passport.ec.europa.eu`) with eIDAS 2.0 Qualified Electronic Seal (QSeal / QES) support
- **Carbon Footprint Declarations (CFD)**: Full PEFCR battery calculation engine for Scope 1, Scope 2, and Scope 3 lifecycle stages

## Commercial Delivery Models
1. **Enterprise DPP Software Suite**: Private cloud / on-premise deployment, full code and data sovereignty, zero per-scan fees, native read-only MES / ERP / PLM / BMS connectors.
2. **10-Year Managed Sovereign Data Vault**: Frankfurt ISO/IEC 27001 data center hosting, 99.9% uptime SLA guarantee, automated 30-day regulatory schema updates, Zero-Knowledge Proof (ZKP) trade secret protection.
